text: I eat lunch here most days. Black coffee, meat and three, and they know my order. Best diner in west Knoxville.
Cornbread is real, sweet tea is right, and the folks are friendly. Hard to beat for the price.
Good as ever, just gets packed by noon. Get there early if you want a booth.
Ribs are solid and the river view is hard to beat after a Vols game. Gets busy on Saturdays.
Took Donna here for an anniversary lunch. Pulled pork was good, service was a touch slow.
They make their own glasses and the beer is excellent. I bring out of town freight folks here every time.
Good local spot. Smaller place so it fills up, but the pours are worth it.
Decent beer and the pizza holds up. Good place to watch a game with the poker boys.
Took Donna here for her birthday. Nicer than our usual but the food and service were worth it.
As a pitmaster myself I am picky about brisket. Theirs has a real smoke ring and good bark. Respect.
Pulled pork and the sauces are great. Lines can get long on the weekend but it moves.
Smoked chicken here is done right. I picked up a tip or two for my own pit. Good people.
Solid ribs close to the house. Not fancy but they know smoke. Sweet tea is good too.
Old school steakhouse done right. The rolls alone are worth the drive down Chapman.
Best burger in Knoxville and the cake case is dangerous. Worth the wait every single time.
Real meat and three. Reminds me of my mama June's table back in Harlan. Get the dumplings.
Reliable spot out west for a quick supper. Wings are good. Service was friendly.
Good casual American food close to Turkey Creek. Easy stop after errands.
Nice riverfront tavern. Good steak, a little pricey, but a fine spot for a client dinner.
Stopped on the way back from the Smokies. Country cooking and big portions. Touristy but tasty.
Good black coffee when I am down in the Old City early. Nothing fancy, just does the job.
Surprisingly good seafood for being inland. The shrimp basket is a solid lunch.
